specs.subject: 100-millisecond-class streaming transcription for voice agents
specs.composition: Horizontal signal laboratory with a live audio waveform entering a streaming transcript rail, a latency clock inset, parallel regional lanes and a voice-response return loop.
specs.mechanism: Show continuous speech packets entering MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming, partial transcript tokens appearing progressively, and a low-latency handoff to a voice-agent reasoning and speech-response loop. Emphasize streaming flow and latency budget without inventing benchmark scores.

specs.subject: Verifiably private federated learning with trusted execution environments
specs.composition: Radial privacy architecture: several device/data silos around a hardware-isolated aggregation chamber, with remote-attestation seals and only an approved aggregate exiting.
specs.mechanism: Show local training updates remaining inside separate organizations, encrypted updates entering a TEE-protected aggregator, remote attestation proving approved code, and only a privacy-preserving global model returning. Make data boundary, compute boundary and proof boundary visually distinct.

specs.subject: Enterprise AI delivery as a professional operating discipline
specs.composition: Layered delivery blueprint shaped like a professional academy curriculum flowing into an enterprise launch gate, with cross-functional competency rails and evidence checkpoints.
specs.mechanism: Show business goals, model capability, risk, evaluation and change management converging through a structured training-and-delivery pathway into an operational launch. Emphasize role clarity, measurable capability and evidence-based delivery rather than a classroom scene.

specs.subject: Personal Agent Gateway for customer service
specs.composition: Mirrored two-sided service exchange: a customer agent and enterprise service agent represented as non-humanoid software nodes meeting at a governed gateway with consent, identity, policy and audit layers.
specs.mechanism: Show a customer-side agent carrying intent and preferences into a Personal Agent Gateway; the gateway verifies identity, consent and policy before the enterprise service agent can retrieve or act; return a traceable resolution. Avoid chatbot UI.

specs.subject: One Agent Skills package reused across Copilot workflows
specs.composition: Central versioned skill cartridge with branching adapters into four distinct workflow lanes, plus a maintenance feedback loop returning improvements to the single source package.
specs.mechanism: Show one packaged skill containing instructions, references and scripts, installed once and invoked from multiple Copilot workflow surfaces. Make reuse, portability, versioning and centralized maintenance visually explicit.

specs.subject: Legal accountability boundary for rogue agents
specs.composition: Forensic incident cross-section: autonomous action trace crossing a bright legal boundary into protected systems, with evidence capture, subpoena, responsibility mapping and remediation chain.
specs.mechanism: Show an agent action log leading from delegated task through external system access, then evidence preservation and legal review that maps responsibility across deployer, operator and provider. Emphasize traceability and accountability without depicting people or sensational imagery.
